data.body: Landed: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1031 (merged as c781127a2). Widened plan_review_precheck's P8-only short-circuit to any DET-floor blocking finding: a DET block now yields the BLOCK verdict (via the same partition_findings/finalize_verdict path, all DET findings carried, coverage.llm_ran=False) with zero LLM invocations. gate_dispatch unchanged (outage path already handled all DET blocks). Tests: inverted test_p1_det_block_still_runs_llm_and_blocks -> test_p1_det_block_short_circuits_before_llm; new tests/unit/workflow/test_det_short_circuit.py (no-LLM BLOCK, finding completeness incl. suggested_fix, DET-passing plans run LLM unchanged). Gates: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 on patchset 2 (ps1 had a CI-only import failure: absolute tests.* import; fixed with a relative import). make lint, make typecheck, and 471 workflow unit tests green.
